config.modulation.title: Modulation Config
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.fix_focu: Fixes a vanilla bug where buttons/sliders retain keyboard focus after being clicked.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.attack_s: Allows you to directly attack villagers while they are sleeping.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.fix_expe: Fixes a vanilla bug where experience levels disappear when changing dimensions without portals.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.fix_reso: Properly couples namespace and path checks for resource filters to prevent them from leaking into other namespaces.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.remove_a: Removes the 'Too Expensive!' 40-level cap on anvils.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.no_anvil: Removes the experience cost when combining enchantments.
Removes the experience cost when repairing items.
Removes the experience cost when renaming items.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.fix_dens: Fixes an exponential performance bug in Minecraft's world generation math. Highly recommended.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.nicer_ma: Replaces standard map colors with softer, more aesthetically pleasing palettes.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.waxed_it: Displays a honeycomb icon on waxed items.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.extra_it: Displays redstone/silverfish icons on trapped chests and infested blocks.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.better_c: Improves formatting and consistency of copper tooltips.
config.modulation.tweak.figura.enable_ta: Modifies the /figura load command with target selection and autocomplete (@a, @s, ...)
config.modulation.tweak.reconnectible_ch: Enables the Chain Staff logic and post placement.
The time (in ticks) required to hold right-click before the staff casts a post (20 ticks = 1 second).
Whether the Chain Staff takes durability damage when placing chains.
Whether the Chain Staff requires and consumes Chains from your inventory.
message.modulation.no_chains: You don't have any Chains in your inventory!
tooltip.modulation.switch_zipline_mode: Shift + Right-Click to switch to Zipline mode
